name: Ligolo-ng
description: A modern tunneling tool that exposes internal networks through a lightweight TUN interface — pivot without proxychains, using normal routing.

install.other: Download proxy and agent binaries from https://github.com/nicocha30/ligolo-ng/releases

commands.explanation: Starts the ligolo-ng proxy with a self-signed certificate and opens its console.

commands.command: ifconfig / ip tuntap add user <you> mode tun ligolo
commands.example: sudo ip tuntap add user kali mode tun ligolo
commands.explanation: Creates the ligolo TUN interface the proxy routes through.

commands.command: sudo ip link set ligolo up
commands.example: sudo ip link set ligolo up

commands.explanation: Run on the pivot host; connects back to the proxy and appears as a session.
Lists connected agents; pick one to make it active.

commands.command: sudo ip route add <subnet> dev ligolo
commands.example: sudo ip route add 172.16.0.0/24 dev ligolo
commands.explanation: Routes an internal subnet through the active session — then use tools normally, no proxychains needed.
Starts the tunnel for the selected session.
Opens a reverse port on the agent that forwards to you — handy for catching shells from the internal network.
